Summary of Examples Update

Source: EXAMPLES_UPDATE_SUMMARY.md

Overview

All examples in the boilerplate R package have been updated to be runnable for CRAN submission. The examples now: - Use temporary directories via tempdir() - Initialize databases with actual data - Clean up after themselves - Run quickly (< 5 seconds) - Set quiet = TRUE to minimize output - Set confirm = FALSE to avoid interactive prompts

Files Updated

Core Functions (3 files)

  1. R/init-functions.R
    • boilerplate_init() - Updated to use temp directories and demonstrate initialization
    • boilerplate_init_category() - Updated with similar pattern
  2. R/generate-text.R
    • boilerplate_generate_text() - Updated to initialize temp databases and show text generation
  3. R/generate-measures.R
    • boilerplate_generate_measures() - Updated to use actual measures from initialized database

Import/Export Functions (1 file)

  1. R/import-export-functions.R
    • boilerplate_import() - Updated to work with temp directories
    • boilerplate_save() - Updated to demonstrate saving and verification
    • boilerplate_export() - Updated to show export to different formats

Helper Functions (4 files)

  1. R/boilerplate_batch_edit_functions.R
    • boilerplate_batch_edit() - Updated to show batch editing with real data
  2. R/boilerplate_standardise_measures.R
    • boilerplate_standardise_measures() - Updated to standardize actual measures
  3. R/category-helpers.R
    • boilerplate_measures() - Updated with runnable example
    • boilerplate_appendix() - Updated with runnable example
    • boilerplate_template() - Updated with runnable example
  4. R/manage-measures.R
    • boilerplate_manage_measures() - Updated to demonstrate add/get/list operations
  5. R/merge-databases.R
    • boilerplate_merge_category() - Updated to merge actual databases
    • boilerplate_merge_unified() - Updated to merge unified databases
    • Path operations example - Updated with basic path checking

Files NOT Updated

  • R/zzz_old_boilerplate_manage_text_functions.R - Deprecated file, left as-is

Key Patterns Used

  1. Temporary Directory Setup

    temp_dir <- tempdir()
data_path <- file.path(temp_dir, "example_name", "data")

  2. Database Initialization

    boilerplate_init(
  categories = c("methods", "measures"),
  data_path = data_path,
  create_dirs = TRUE,
  create_empty = FALSE,
  confirm = FALSE,
  quiet = TRUE
)

  3. Cleanup

    unlink(file.path(temp_dir, "example_name"), recursive = TRUE)

Testing Recommendation

Run R CMD check to ensure all examples execute properly and within time limits.
